headline: Maui Planning Commission Meeting - South Maui Plan

meeting.body: Maui Planning Commission Meeting - South Maui Plan
meeting.summary: The Maui Planning Commission heard testimony on the South Maui Community Plan, including the Promenade property, and took no action.
meeting.recap: The Maui Planning Commission met to review the South Maui Community Plan.[[0:00:35]] The chair said the meeting would end at 5:00 so people could attend a South Maui budget session that evening.[[0:03:02]] A resort employee asked to remove two gulch and drainage areas from the plan maps.[[0:05:36]] A speaker for four short-term rental properties with 782 owners asked to change them from residential to resort hotel.[[0:16:15]] Another testifier supported keeping the gulches on the maps.[[0:24:30]] He said the project would then be mostly housing.[[0:39:23]] A landowner's representative said a proposed 150-foot setback would cut into land set aside for workforce housing at the 670 property.[[0:57:39]] A ranch representative asked to designate about 80 acres above the wastewater treatment plant for industrial use.[[1:17:54]] The commission took no action, so the next agenda will be largely the same.[[1:47:18]]
meeting.next: The planning department reminded commissioners to watch the South Maui advisory committee's housing forum. The next meeting will have largely the same agenda because the commission did not take action.
